svg.title: Neurovascular modeling and evaluation
svg.desc: Study workflow. The five Gamma HRFs are shown at unit peak. The HbO reconstruction branches use HEFMI-ICH. FastSlow-NVC combines fast EEG with HRF-filtered envelopes and fits each cohort separately. HEFMI-ICH decoding also uses a LOSO NVC prior fitted on other participants. Closed-form ICH screening uses paired EEG and measured HbO under outer LOSO.
